meta.title: Lotties: track your baby's day, together

hero.headline: Track your baby's day, together
hero.sub: Sleep, feeds, diapers and medicines in one calm place. Works offline, shares with your co-parent.

log.title: Log in two taps
log.body: One-tap tiles, timers for naps and feeds, and an undo for the moment your thumb slips.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Installs like an app and keeps working without a connection. Everything syncs when it is back.

share.title: Share with your co-parent
share.body: Invite someone with a link and see who logged what, so nobody has to ask.

predict.title: Gentle predictions
predict.body: See the next nap window with a plain explanation of how it was worked out. Estimates from your logged history, not medical advice.

history.title: Bring your history
history.body: Import from Napper, add your own event types, and track medicines with safe intervals. The doctor's prescription is always the source.

data.title: Your data, your rules
data.body: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0) and can be self-hosted. No ads, no tracking.

one.title: Sign in
one.body: Create an account or sign in. It takes a minute.

two.title: Add your baby
two.body: Log sleep, feeds, diapers and medicines as they happen.

three.title: Invite your co-parent
three.body: Share a link. You both see the same day.

footer.licence: Free and open source software, licensed under the AGPL-3.0.

important.title: Not a medical device
important.body: Estimates come from your logged history and are not medical advice. Lotties helps you keep a record and spot patterns; it does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
important.care: For any health concern, or before giving or changing a medicine, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
